card.name: Prior or current treatment status in dosing
card.fires_on: Words like treated, treatment, previous or currently that describe a patient's existing or prior therapy. Seen in starting-dose instructions such as "in patients not currently treated with".

modes.label: Treated with
modes.description: The word treated after currently, already or not, naming a drug the patient is or is not on.
modes.example: In patients currently not<< treated>> with metformin HCl, initiate

modes.label: Prior therapy
modes.description: Words like previous, treatment or currently that mark earlier or ongoing therapy before a dosing instruction.
modes.example: In patients who have not received<< previous>> antituberculous therapy, administer

card.writes: It promotes the word existing, so the model expects wording about existing therapy next.
card.plain: It marks phrases about whether a patient is already on, or has had, a certain treatment before dosing advice.
